Paragliding (training hill lessons + beginner wing/harness/helmet) — estimated start-up cost: $3,500–$7,000.  
Sea kayaking with a local paddling club (kayak + PFD + paddle + basic safety gear) — estimated start-up cost: $900–$2,500.  
Outdoor rock climbing (shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, rope, quickdraws; plus gym intro course to meet people) — estimated start-up cost: $600–$1,500.  
GPS geocaching (handheld GPS unit or upgraded phone setup + small kit for swaps) — estimated start-up cost: $100–$400.  
Trail running with a running group (shoes + basic weather layers/vest) — estimated start-up cost: $80–$250.  
Park volunteer days like trail cleanups or invasive-plant pulls (work gloves + water bottle; tools often provided) — estimated start-up cost: $10–$40.
